name: levels: build, Home finished, the last home job done
setup: (async()=>{const L=await import('./js/desk/levels.js'); localStorage.setItem('e4-network-v1', JSON.stringify({t:{}, solved:Object.fromEntries(L.LEVELS[0].tickets.map(id=>[id,1]))})); localStorage.setItem('e4-build-v1', JSON.stringify({j:{}, done:Object.fromEntries(L.LEVELS[0].jobs.map(id=>[id,1]))})); const c=window.__e4b; c.openJob('J10',true,4242); const J=c.T; J.def.solve(J.v,J.sim).forEach(a=>c.act(a)); c.check();})()

name: levels: instructor dialog with the Levels section
office: SO-J1 first check, console cable laid, serial terminal with ? help
setup: sessionStorage.setItem('e4-instructor','1'); const c=window.__e4b; c.openJob('SO-J1',true,4242); c.check(); c.act({t:'place',dev:'msw',room:'closet'}); c.act({t:'lay',a:{dev:'tech',port:'USB-C'},b:{dev:'msw',port:'CONSOLE'}}); document.querySelector('#devtabs [data-d=tech]').click(); const k=(v,key)=>{const i=document.querySelector('.term .cmdin'); if(v!=null) i.value=v; i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:key||'Enter',bubbles:true}));}; k(''); k('enable'); k('','?');

name: office: SO-J1 console password prompt, Mason's third rung
setup: sessionStorage.setItem('e4-instructor','1'); const c=window.__e4b; c.openJob('SO-J1',true,4242); const J=c.T; J.def.solve(J.v,J.sim).slice(0,-2).forEach(a=>c.act(a)); for(let i=0;i<5;i++) c.check(); c.act({t:'cmd',dev:'tech',line:'disable',cli:true}); c.act({t:'cmd',dev:'tech',line:'exit',cli:true}); document.querySelector('#devtabs [data-d=tech]').click(); const k=(v,key)=>{const i=document.querySelector('.term .cmdin'); if(v!=null) i.value=v; i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:key||'Enter',bubbles:true}));}; k('');

name: office: SO-J1 done, the managed switch's 3D model with the console cable
setup: sessionStorage.setItem('e4-instructor','1'); const c=window.__e4b; c.openJob('SO-J1',true,4242); const J=c.T; J.def.solve(J.v,J.sim).forEach(a=>c.act(a)); c.check(); document.querySelector('#devtabs [data-d=msw]').click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('.win-tabs button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Physical').click();

setup: sessionStorage.setItem('e4-instructor','1'); const c=window.__e4b; c.openJob('SO-J2',true,4242); const J=c.T; J.def.solve(J.v,J.sim).forEach(a=>c.act(a)); c.check(); document.querySelector('#devtabs [data-d=msw]').click();

name: office: SO-J2 done, the logical diagram, SSH from the PC
setup: sessionStorage.setItem('e4-instructor','1'); const c=window.__e4b; c.openJob('SO-J2',true,4242); const J=c.T, p=J.sim.net.plan; J.def.solve(J.v,J.sim).forEach(a=>c.act(a)); c.check(); document.getElementById('vLog').click(); document.querySelector('#devtabs [data-d=pc]').click(); [...document.querySelectorAll('.win-tabs button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Command Prompt').click(); const k=(v,key)=>{const i=document.querySelector('.term .cmdin'); if(v!=null) i.value=v; i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:key||'Enter',bubbles:true}));}; k('ssh '+p.user+'@'+p.ip); k(p.userPw); k('show ip interface brief');

name: office: SO-J2 old switch pulled, runs table with a dead run
setup: sessionStorage.setItem('e4-instructor','1'); const c=window.__e4b; c.openJob('SO-J2',true,4242); c.act({t:'pull',cable:'c-old-pc'}); c.act({t:'lay',a:{dev:'msw',port:'2'},b:{dev:'pc',port:'NIC'}}); c.act({t:'cmd',dev:'tech',line:'',cli:true}); for(let i=0;i<3;i++) c.check();
